title: Why Every Missouri CDS Family Needs a Backup Caregiver (and How to Find One)
short_title: Why every CDS family needs a backup caregiver
description: Even when a family member is your main CDS caregiver, life happens: the flu, a broken-down car, a well-earned vacation. Here's why every Consumer Directed Services family needs a backup caregiver, and how Find CDS Caregivers helps you meet screened caregivers near you. Free to look, no obligation, and you choose who you hire.

parts.head: Why every CDS family needs a backup caregiver
parts.sub: And how to find one you trust
parts.text: Your daughter is your CDS caregiver. Then she gets the flu. Or the car breaks down. Or she finally takes a vacation. Who comes then? I'm Samantha with Caring Companions CDS. Here's why every CDS family needs a backup caregiver, and how to find one.

parts.head: Life happens
parts.sub: Without a backup, a sick day can mean no care
parts.text: Even when a family member is the main caregiver, life happens. People get sick, kids need them, cars break down. Without a backup, a sick day can mean no care at all.

parts.head: Missouri asks for a backup plan
parts.sub: The best plan is a real person you've met
parts.text: Missouri asks every CDS employer to have a backup plan. And the best backup plan is a real person you've already met.

parts.head: Rest for your main caregiver
parts.sub: A day off, a doctor visit, a ballgame
parts.text: A backup isn't only for emergencies. It means your main caregiver can take a day off, see their own doctor, or go to a grandkid's ballgame, and your care still happens. Caregivers need rest, too.

parts.head: Find CDS Caregivers
parts.sub: A private directory for CDS families
parts.text: That's why we made Find CDS Caregivers, a private caregiver directory for families in the CDS program. You can see caregiver profiles in their own words, with a photo, the area they live in, and their general availability.

parts.head: Meet them first
parts.sub: Meeting doesn't commit you. You choose.
parts.text: Many caregivers add a short hello video. When someone looks like a good fit, you ask to meet them. Meeting someone doesn't commit you, or them. You still choose who you hire.

parts.head: Screening complete
parts.sub: Every caregiver you can meet has finished the state's screening
parts.text: Every caregiver you can ask to meet has finished the state's required screening.

parts.head: Free to look
parts.sub: No obligation, even to choose us as your agency
parts.text: It's free to look, and there's no obligation. You don't even have to choose Caring Companions CDS as your agency to browse.

parts.head: Same rules as your main caregiver
parts.sub: Hired by you, within your hours, paid every Thursday
parts.text: A backup caregiver follows the same rules as your main caregiver. They're hired by you, they work within the hours in your plan of care, and they're paid fifteen to sixteen dollars an hour, every Thursday.

parts.head: Be someone's backup caregiver
parts.sub: A free profile takes about 2 minutes
parts.text: And if you'd like to be someone's backup caregiver, make a free profile. It takes about two minutes, and no experience is needed.
Request your private invitation at findcdscaregivers.com, or call us at 417-218-2888. I'm Samantha with Caring Companions CDS. Thanks for watching.
